title: The Mist Age - Learn Spell
description: Learning new spells for Daggerheart characters: study a spell book (or a spell the GM gives) as a project; every attempt costs silver in alchemy and magic materials and sheets of paper, the progress moves with Hope and Fear, and the learnt spell is added to the character as a domain card.

recommends.reason: Material prices and currency rates for the cost of each attempt; without it every material costs 1 Silver.
